Title: Admin Configuration Surface Current State
Content: The /admin workbench is the authenticated Admin surface for users, providers, Tag Manager access, configuration, audit, and history. Configuration rows come from AdminSettingsService.ListEditableSettings, persist through AdminSettingsService.UpdateAsync into appsettings.LocalDevelopment.json or MemorySmith:SettingsOverridePath, reload IConfigurationRoot, and record settings.updated audit entries. The Configuration tab now covers broad MemorySmithOptions groups and each editable row exposes an info-circle tooltip sourced from AdminSettingItem.HelpText. Sensitive values such as API keys, OAuth secrets, bootstrap token hashes, and database connection strings are write-only in the UI: the table reports Configured or Not configured but does not echo the stored value. The Admin Tags tab links directly to /tags so tag governance is visible from the same operator workbench.
